decision_bar.statement: error and ranking criteria met on 105 held-out compiled rows, but they come from 1 M4 program(s) (hpcg) and 2 microbenchmark families; the bar asks for loops from at least 5 M4 programs, so it is not met yet

notes: predicted = slope of completion cycles between 2 and 4 rounds, divided by 32 units per round; TSC ticks and core cycles are treated as equal (0.5% difference on this card)
footprints that fit L1 (L2) with all active threads are declared warm in L1 (L2) because the driver measures a warm steady state; larger footprints start cold
the kernel catalog was regenerated from tests/bench/knc-char/kernels.py; S8-07 additions shift kernel indices but the measured S6-03 bodies are the same templates
calibration rows set a parameter of the profile and are excluded from the held-out statistics
every prediction is a model output; the measured column is native

compiled rows (tests/heldout_native/<case>/) come from the binaries and objects that ran on the card, with code layout; seconds converted with card.clock_hz 1.238 GHz; variants marked 'calibrates' in a case.json set a model rule and are calibration rows; each prediction is recorded in the case's prediction.json
decision bar (compiled held-out rows only): median absolute error at most 10%, right winner in at least 90% of within-group pairs measured more than 5% apart, at least 50 loops

calibration.statement: Core timing is inherited from core-x100-measured (measured or derived on this card: S6-03, S8-01, S8-12, S12-31). Predictions were compared with 119 characterization rows (held-out median error 0.9/2.7/1.4% at 1/2/4 threads, ranking 0.984) and with 105 held-out compiled rows from the binaries that ran on the card (S12-31 row loops, HPCG kernels L2-resident and memory-bound, S12-30 sparse products): median error 3.2%, right winner 39 of 39 pairs more than 5% apart. The decision bar's error and ranking criteria are met; its breadth (loops from at least five M4 programs) is not: shapes outside validated_shapes are unvalidated_scenario_estimate. First 0.3.0 pass; see references/validation.md for the status of the rerun.
